title: 【死亡细胞】储君皮肤MOD：国王与夜歌 (The Beheaded / King)
description:
[b]“只要你记得对我好，我们或许也可以在一起玩得很开心……” —— 夜歌[/b]

本项目是一个面向《杀戮尖塔 2》的高质量角色视觉替换 Mod。我们将游戏中的 [b]储君 (REGENT)[/b] 全链路重构为《死亡细胞 (Dead Cells)》中的 [b]“国王 + 夜歌”[/b] 主题风格！

这不是简单的模型替换，而是从底层重构了角色的动作、特效与交互逻辑，为您带来极其沉浸的一体化体验。

[hr][/hr]
[h2]✨ 核心亮点 (Features)[/h2]

[list]
[*] 👑 [b]全场景视觉接管[/b]：涵盖选人界面、战斗实体、商店驻留、篝火休息及顶部栏头像的完整模型与 UI 替换。
[*] 🎭 [b]皮肤与演出设置[/b]。选中储君后，点击右上角齿轮切换蓝王／白王与加速／原作节奏，设置自动保存。
[*] ⚔️ [b]13 套武器、44 段攻击[/b]。新增巨型剪刀、双截锅与迅捷弓，动作、刀光和声音采用对应的演出时序。
[*] ✨ [b]光效披风[/b]。随动作与风向摆动，配色跟随蓝王／白王皮肤，每场战斗随机抽取风向。
[*] 🔊 [b]原版音效与受击表现[/b]。使用死亡细胞挥击、击中、格挡和受伤声音，加入敌人血液喷溅、受击闪色及致死碎块。
[*] 🛡️ [b]盾牌分流[/b]。完全格挡时举盾，掉血时受伤，还原三面盾的动作、光效与声音。
[*] 🌐 [b]多语言[/b]。角色介绍、设置与夜歌台词支持简体中文、英语和日语。
[*] 🦇 [b]夜歌联动系统 (Serenade System)[/b]：
  - [b]卡牌响应[/b]：识别特定卡牌（如“君王之剑”）触发夜歌轮盘连击与残影视觉。
  - [b]形态平滑切换[/b]：从肩部漂浮的“幼年期”到独立飞剑的“完全体”无缝过渡。
  - [b]专属弹幕引擎[/b]：根据战斗情境（受击、铸造、待机等），夜歌会自动触发极其符合原版“病娇”人设的文字弹幕演出！
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚠️ 兼容性说明 (Compatibility)[/h2]

[list]
[*] 当前更新适配 [b]beta 0.113[/b]，已检查与未锈铠、苏芙比同装时的补丁加载兼容。
[*] 本 Mod 当前仅对 [b]储君 (REGENT)[/b] 生效，绝对不影响其他原版角色。
[*] 若您订阅了其他深度修改“选人界面UI”或“顶部栏头像逻辑”的 Mod，可能会产生冲突。
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚖️ 引用、致谢与版权声明 (Credits & License)[/h2]

[list]
[*] 💻 [b]源码逻辑[/b]：本项目的底层逻辑代码由作者独立完成，采用 [b]MIT License[/b]。
[*] 🎮 [b]原作致谢[/b]：感谢 [b]MegaCrit[/b] 开发的《杀戮尖塔 2》，以及 [b]Motion Twin & Evil Empire[/b] 创作的《死亡细胞》中极其经典的枭首者/国王形象。
[*] 🎨 [b]美术与音频资产[/b]：本项目所配套的美术序列帧、音频素材均通过官方公开工具解包获取，版权完全归属于原开发商。本 Mod 仅作非盈利的同人交流与跨界联动展示，请勿用于任何商业行为！

[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🌐 English Description[/h2]

[b]"As long as you remember to be nice to me, we might just have a lot of fun together..." — Serenade[/b]

This is a high-quality visual overhaul Mod for Slay the Spire 2. We have completely transformed [b]The REGENT[/b] into the [b]"King + Serenade"[/b] theme from [i]Dead Cells[/i]! 

This is not a simple model swap. We have reconstructed the character's animations, VFX, and interaction logic from the ground up to create an incredibly immersive and seamless experience.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]✨ Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] 👑 [b]Full Visual Overhaul[/b]: Complete model and UI replacement covering the character select screen, combat entities, merchant interactions, campfire resting, and the top-bar portrait.
[*] 🎭 [b]Outfit and animation settings[/b]. Select the Regent and click the upper-right gear to choose Blue/White King and Fast/Original pacing. Preferences are saved automatically.
[*] ⚔️ [b]13 weapon sets and 44 attack stages[/b]. Includes Giant Scissors, Panchaku and Quick Bow, with coordinated animations, trails and audio.
[*] ✨ [b]Light-trail cape[/b]. Outfit-specific colors, animation-driven movement and three wind presets selected per battle.
[*] 🔊 [b]Original sounds and hit feedback[/b]. Dead Cells swing, impact, block and hurt sounds, plus enemy blood splashes, damage flashes and lethal fragments.
[*] 🛡️ [b]Shield reactions[/b]. Fully blocked attacks use shield animations, while HP loss triggers hurt animations. Three shields feature original frames, effects and audio.
[*] 🌐 [b]Languages[/b]. Character text, settings and Serenade dialogue support Simplified Chinese, English and Japanese.
[*] 🦇 [b]Serenade Synergy System[/b]:
  - [b]Card Reactivity[/b]: Playing specific cards triggers Serenade's roulette combos and afterimage effects.
  - [b]Form Switching[/b]: Smooth transitions from floating on the shoulder to an independent flying sword.
  - [b]Custom Danmaku Engine[/b]: Depending on the combat situation, Serenade will trigger floating text dialogs that perfectly capture its original yandere/tsundere personality!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚠️ Compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*] Updated for [b]beta 0.113[/b], with patch-load compatibility checks for AKnightSkin and SothebySkin.
[*] This Mod currently ONLY affects [b]The REGENT[/b] and will not alter other original characters.
[*] Potential conflicts may arise if you use other Mods that deeply modify the character select UI or top-bar portrait logic.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]⚖️ Credits & License[/h2]

[list]
[*] 💻 [b]Source Code[/b]: The underlying logic code is developed independently by the author and is under the [b]MIT License[/b].
[*] 🎮 [b]Special Thanks[/b]: Thanks to [b]MegaCrit[/b] for Slay the Spire 2, and to [b]Motion Twin & Evil Empire[/b] for the iconic Beheaded/King from Dead Cells.
[*] 🎨 [b]Assets[/b]: Visual frames and audio assets used in this Mod were extracted using official tools. All copyrights belong to the original developers. This Mod is strictly for non-profit, fan-made cross-over appreciation.
[*] 💬 [b]Community[/b]: Thanks to the Dead Cells community for the dialog text compilations that helped bring Serenade's authentic interactions to life.
[/list]
